title_zh: 根据比赛录像安排防守调整试验

scenario.label_zh: 根据比赛录像安排防守调整试验
scenario.goal_zh: 指出录像中的局势变化并约定训练中试验较保守的防守策略

context_zh: 两名业余足球教练回看虚构比赛录像，讨论训练安排而非真实赛事新闻。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: Pause it there. That's where the swing in momentum starts.

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.text: Our full-back moves forward, and the other team immediately uses the space behind him.

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: So chasing the ball wasn't a good tactic in that situation.

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.text: We could make a tactical adjustment and keep one defender deeper.

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: Let's test that in training before deciding on the line-up for the next match.

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.text: Agreed. We'll review whether it actually closes that gap.
